hypothesis: Average independent training initializations as well as training snapshots to reduce optimization variability; all nine contiguous seeds are retained in three disjoint ensembles.

candidate.raw_snapshot_selection: highest clean validation mAP across every epoch, ties choose latest
candidate.average_snapshot: uniform end-of-epoch parameters for epochs 61 through 120, final average only
candidate.training_budget_note: Nine 120-epoch expert trajectories per deployed ensemble, 1080 total epochs; two snapshots each, no extra training for snapshots

controls: Three-initialization committees for every raw, averaged and two-snapshot unimodal expert
Three-initialization raw feature fusion at 120 and 360 epochs (360 matches candidate training-update budget)
Three-initialization averaged and two-snapshot feature fusion at 120 epochs

fresh_holdout.policy: All three predeclared disjoint initialization groups count. Freeze all checkpoint and source hashes before fresh holdout scoring. No later tuning against fresh holdout.

metrics.seed_sd_semantics: Sample SD across three disjoint ensembles, each trained with three independent initialization seeds; not single-initialization SD.

retained_failures: Raw consensus historical test clean SD .0456; averaged-only validation clean SD .0347 across five seeds; two-snapshot confirmatory validation clean SD .0482 across seeds16/17/18. None met the complete goal.
